name: Radio
description: FM/AM/DAB+ radio with an RTL-SDR USB stick: station scan, favorites, RDS (station name, radio text, PI) and DAB+ with DLS and slideshow (decoders included), station logos from your own image files. For testing without a stick: a simulated stick with internet radio streams.

settings.title: Tuner gain (dB)
settings.description: Lower it when strong stations distort

settings.title: Frequency correction (ppm)
settings.description: For sticks whose stations are slightly off

settings.title: Antenna power (bias-T)
settings.description: Powers an active antenna through the stick (DAB+)

settings.title: RDS
settings.description: Station names and radio text on FM

settings.title: Pause for other sources
settings.description: Stops when Android Auto or another source starts playing
